verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships its own CLI binary that starts the server from the command line: `local-ai run <model>` loads a model and serves it, documented server flags include `--preload-models` and `--external-grpc-backends`, and `local-ai models list` manages models. A Docker run command is also documented. Stopping the server is never explicitly covered; it is only implied by the foreground process model. missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown or daemon-management command, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI lifecycle
